2.204.27
StateIndicator.UseFontPercent
Applies to RDL 2008/01
The StateIndicator.UseFontPercent element is ignored if it is present. However, its data type is
validated, and the value MUST be a Boolean ([XMLSCHEMA2/2] section 3.2.2) or an expression that
evaluates to a Boolean. If this element is not present, its value is interpreted as false.
The following is the parent element of the StateIndicator.UseFontPercent element.
Parent elements
StateIndicator
The following is the XML Schema definition of the StateIndicator.UseFontPercent element.
 <xsd:element name="UseFontPercent" type="xsd:string" minOccurs="0" />
